templates.title: 3D Orbit Reveal
templates.creator: cliphou.se
templates.prompt: A 7 second 16:9 3D reveal: a ring of glossy blocks spins in, settles in orbit, and frames a brand line, title, and subtitle.

templates.title: Photo Title Card
templates.creator: cliphou.se
templates.prompt: A 6 second 16:9 photo title card: a full-bleed photo pushes in while a colored rule and gradient wipe in, then a title reveals from the left.

templates.title: 3D Logo Reveal
templates.creator: cliphou.se
templates.prompt: A 7 second 16:9 3D logo reveal for any brand. A cluster of glossy shards (thin beveled boxes and tetrahedrons in accent and accent2) floats in deep space, then snaps together into a solid faceted emblem in the center while the camera dollies in and orbits 30 degrees. A sharp light sweep crosses the emblem at the moment it locks. The brand name rises in large letters under the emblem, then the headline appears as a smaller line, and finally a short call to action pill fades in at the bottom. Background is a dark gradient from theme.background to theme.surface with a soft floor reflection. Calm settle for the last second so it loops well as an intro.

templates.title: VHS Intro
templates.creator: cliphou.se
templates.prompt: A 6 second 16:9 retro VHS intro. Start on tracking noise and rolling horizontal bands, then a blue-screen PLAY overlay in the corner with a blinking timecode built from the date text. The headline appears in chunky italic type with chromatic aberration (offset accent and accent2 copies) and slight horizontal jitter, then stabilizes. Scanlines, a soft vignette, and occasional tape warp lines cross the frame. The brand appears like a channel bug in the top right. Use deterministic random(seed) for all noise. End stable for one second.

templates.title: Photo Quote
templates.creator: cliphou.se
templates.prompt: An 8 second 9:16 photo quote for Reels and Stories. A full-frame photo slowly drifts upward with a gentle zoom. A large opening quotation mark draws in with accent color, then the quote reveals line by line in a big serif font in the lower half, followed by a thin rule and the author name. The brand sits small at the top. Use the Backdrop component so the quote stays readable over any of the template's photos and themes. Quiet, editorial pacing.

templates.title: 3D Title Card
templates.creator: cliphou.se
templates.prompt: A 6 second 16:9 3D title card. A row of tall glossy pillars (one per letter-sized slot, 9 to 12 pillars) rises out of a reflective floor in a wave from left to right while the camera slowly tracks sideways and tilts down. The pillars settle into a gentle stepped skyline behind the title. The headline appears in large bold HTML type over the scene once the wave passes the center, with the brand above it and the subhead below. Lighting is a soft key from the top left with accent rim light. Calm final second.

templates.title: 3D Product Turntable
templates.creator: cliphou.se
templates.prompt: An 8 second 16:9 3D product turntable for any product. A generic premium object (a rounded capsule-shaped device built from a torus, a cylinder, and a sphere, in surface and accent colors) rotates slowly on a round pedestal with a soft reflection and a ring of light under it. The camera orbits 45 degrees and dollies in. On the left, the brand appears small, then the headline in large type, then a price tag chip, then a call to action button that pulses once. Studio lighting with a key, fill, and accent rim light. Smooth and premium.

templates.title: 3D Countdown
templates.creator: cliphou.se
templates.prompt: An 8 second 16:9 3D countdown. Three large extruded numerals made from stacked boxes (3, 2, 1, each built from a 5x7 grid of cubes) appear one after the other: the cubes of each numeral fly in from depth and assemble, hold, then scatter outward as the next one forms. Each numeral lasts about 60 frames. After 1 scatters, the headline appears in large HTML type with the date below and the brand above. Accent and accent2 colored cubes, dark background with depth fog.

templates.title: Chrome Intro
templates.creator: cliphou.se
templates.prompt: A 6 second 16:9 chrome intro. A cluster of polished metallic shapes (torus, sphere, rounded box, cone) floats in a soft gradient studio and slowly rotates, reflecting accent and accent2 colored lights (use metalness 1 and low roughness with colored point lights so the reflections read as chrome). The shapes drift apart to the edges to open the center, where the headline appears in very large type, with the brand above and a small call to action below. Glossy, Y2K, premium.

templates.title: Isometric Feature List
templates.creator: cliphou.se
templates.prompt: A 9 second 16:9 isometric feature list. An orthographic-style camera (narrow field of view, far away) looks down at an isometric grid floor. Three isometric blocks of different heights rise one by one from the floor, each with a small icon-like shape on top (a sphere, a cone, a ring). As each block rises, its feature label (point1, point2, point3) appears in HTML next to it with a short connector line. The headline sits at the top left; the call to action appears at the end. Clean, friendly, product-explainer style.

templates.title: Clay 3D Intro
templates.creator: cliphou.se
templates.prompt: A 7 second 16:9 soft clay 3D intro. Chunky rounded clay-like shapes (spheres, capsules made from cylinders with sphere caps, rounded boxes) in pastel versions of the theme colors bounce in with squash-and-stretch (scale on landing) onto a soft floor, then settle into a playful arrangement around the center. Use meshStandardMaterial with high roughness (0.8) and no metalness for a matte clay look, with soft lighting. The headline pops in with a bouncy scale, the brand above, the subhead below. Playful and friendly.

templates.title: Paper Cutout Title
templates.creator: cliphou.se
templates.prompt: A 7 second 16:9 paper cutout title. Layered torn-paper hills and clouds (SVG shapes with slightly irregular edges and soft drop shadows between layers) slide in from the bottom and top with a gentle parallax and a small bounce. Each layer uses a theme color. The headline appears as a cut-out paper label with a slight rotation and a shadow, then the subhead below it, with the brand on a small paper tag pinned at the top. Handmade and warm.

templates.title: Pixel Arcade Intro
templates.creator: cliphou.se
templates.prompt: A 6 second 16:9 pixel arcade intro. A blocky pixel grid scene: a starfield of square pixels scrolls down, a chunky pixel frame draws itself, and the headline appears in a blocky pixel style (render letters with heavy weight, uppercase, and a hard stepped drop shadow; no external pixel fonts). A blinking PRESS START style cta appears below, and the subhead scrolls in like a game prompt. Use stepped (frame-quantized) motion for an 8-bit feel. Deterministic random(seed) for stars.

templates.title: Doodle Explainer
templates.creator: cliphou.se
templates.prompt: A 7 second 16:9 hand-drawn doodle explainer. Sketchy SVG lines draw on (stroke-dashoffset) as if drawn with a marker: an underline under the headline, circles around three points, arrows between them, and small stars. Lines have a slight wobble (precomputed with random(seed)). The headline is written first, then point1, point2, point3 appear in a row each circled by a drawn loop with an arrow to the next. Paper-white or theme background, ink in foreground color with accent highlights.

templates.title: Magazine Cover
templates.creator: cliphou.se
templates.prompt: An 8 second 9:16 editorial magazine cover. The brand is a huge masthead across the top in a condensed serif, revealed by a mask wipe. Thin rules and a small date line sit under it. A large color block (accent) slides in as the cover image area with a subtle animated grain and geometric shapes. The headline is set as a big cover line in serif italic at the lower left, the subhead as a smaller coverline. A barcode-like stripe pattern appears at the bottom corner. Fashion editorial pacing.

templates.title: Liquid Gradient
templates.creator: cliphou.se
templates.prompt: An 8 second 16:9 liquid gradient intro. Large soft blobs of accent, accent2, and surface color flow and morph slowly behind a frosted layer (animated SVG path morphs or radial gradients moving on looping paths), producing a smooth flowing liquid gradient. Do not use separate decorative orbs; the blobs must merge into one continuous gradient field. The headline reveals word by word in large clean type, the brand above, the cta as a glassy pill below. Calm and modern.

templates.title: Cyber Glitch Title
templates.creator: cliphou.se
templates.prompt: A 6 second 16:9 cyber glitch title. A dark grid with scanning lines and a HUD frame. The headline appears through digital glitch bursts: horizontal slice offsets, RGB split copies in accent and accent2, block noise, and brief character scrambles that settle into the real text. The date appears as a terminal-style readout, the brand as a HUD tag in the corner. Bursts at irregular but deterministic frames (random(seed)). End stable.

templates.title: Photo Lower Third
templates.creator: cliphou.se
templates.prompt: A 6 second 16:9 lower third over a full-frame photo. The photo pushes in slowly. A lower third slides in at the bottom left: an accent bar wipes in, then the author name in bold, then the attribution line (role or title) below it, and the brand as a small tag at the right end of the bar. Hold, then the lower third slides out in the last 20 frames. Use one zone for the lower third area only, so the photo stays clear elsewhere.

templates.title: Photo Slideshow
templates.creator: cliphou.se
templates.prompt: A 10 second 16:9 photo slideshow with three photos. Each photo fills the frame for about 90 frames with a slow Ken Burns move (alternate push-in and pull-out, alternate pan direction), joined by a quick diagonal wipe in the accent color. Each slide shows one item from the items list (split by comma) as a caption in the lower left. The headline appears on the first slide above its caption; the brand sits small in the top right throughout. Use Backdrop for each slide with a zone over the caption area.

templates.title: Before and After Photo
templates.creator: cliphou.se
templates.prompt: An 8 second 16:9 before and after reveal with two photos of the same place. The before photo fills the frame first. A vertical divider with a round handle sweeps from the left edge to the center, revealing the after photo on its left side, then nudges right and back. Label chips read point1 on the before side and point2 on the after side. The headline appears at the top center, the brand small at the bottom. Use inline Img for both photos inside clipped containers and a Backdrop-style scrim only behind the headline.

templates.title: Travel Intro
templates.creator: cliphou.se
templates.prompt: A 7 second 9:16 travel or location intro for Reels. A full-frame vertical photo slowly pushes in. A thin route line draws a looping path across the upper area and ends in a location pin. The headline (a place name) appears very large in the center in bold condensed type, letter by letter, with the date below it in a pill and the brand at the bottom. Adventurous and bright.

templates.title: Portrait Speaker Card
templates.creator: cliphou.se
templates.prompt: A 7 second 9:16 speaker or profile card. A photo appears inside a large rounded rectangle frame in the upper half (inline Img, not full frame), sliding up with a subtle parallax. Below it, the name (author) in large bold type, the role (attribution) in a smaller line, and a short quote in a card. The brand sits at the top. Theme background fills the frame; the photo is the hero element.

templates.title: Signal Launch

templates.prompt: A 9 second 16:9 HyperFrames launch film with a sweeping signal line, three raised feature cards, and a circular reveal to the call to action.

templates.title: Ring Stat

templates.prompt: An 8 second square HyperFrames stat recap: concentric rings draw around a key number, then a solid panel explains the result.

templates.title: Event Pass

templates.prompt: A 10 second vertical HyperFrames event promo: a ticket drops into frame, then the program slides in as a staggered list.

templates.title: Pull Quote

templates.prompt: A 9 second 4:5 HyperFrames quote card with a large quotation mark, masked quote reveal, author line, and a closing call to action.

templates.title: Price Drop
templates.creator: hf.lab
templates.prompt: An 8 second 16:9 HyperFrames sale promo where diagonal panels slide in and a swinging price tag lands before the offer screen.

templates.prompt: A 16 second 16:9 Remotion showreel on a 120 BPM score: one accent bar keeps time through kinetic type, a list, a 3D cube, a counting stat, and an end title.

templates.creator: cliphouse.studio
templates.prompt: A 10 second vertical Remotion product promo on a 120 BPM score: an accent dot pulses on the kick, becomes the claim's underline, marks three benefits, and grows into the CTA button.

templates.title: Feature Drop
templates.creator: cliphouse.studio
templates.prompt: A 7.5 second square HyperFrames launch on a 128 BPM score: a launch card splits into three feature tiles on the beat and folds back into the brand lockup.

templates.title: Event Countdown

templates.prompt: A 12 second 4:5 HyperFrames event promo on a 120 BPM score: a ticket stub becomes the date, the agenda, a three-beat countdown, and a stamped CTA on the final impact.

templates.title: Changelog
templates.creator: cliphouse.studio
templates.prompt: A 4:5 weekly changelog post. A version tag and the week, then up to five shipped items print onto a release log one per beat, each read as its own line (the user may prefix them with New, Improved, or Fixed), then the CTA. Built for X and LinkedIn feeds.

templates.title: Now in Beta
templates.creator: cliphouse.studio
templates.prompt: A 1:1 "now in beta" announcement. A beta badge stamps onto the feature name, the subhead says who can join, and the CTA invites people in. Confident and a little playful.

templates.title: Version Reveal
templates.creator: cliphouse.studio
templates.prompt: A 16:9 major version reveal. The version number is the hero: its characters slam or roll into place, the headline names the release, up to three highlights land, then the CTA. Feels like a keynote title card.

templates.title: Shipped
templates.creator: cliphouse.studio
templates.prompt: A 9:16 "we shipped it" story. A deploy progress bar fills, a SHIPPED stamp lands, the feature name and subhead read clearly, then the CTA. Built for Reels, TikTok, and Stories.

templates.title: Feature List
templates.creator: cliphouse.studio
templates.prompt: A 1:1 launch post that lists what is new. The headline sets it up, then up to six features stack into a clean grid or list, each with a check mark landing on its beat, and the CTA closes.

templates.title: Metric Bump
templates.creator: cliphouse.studio
templates.prompt: A 4:5 metric milestone post. A big number snaps into place, the headline says what it measures, a short note gives context, then the brand and CTA. Celebratory but credible, for founders sharing traction.

templates.title: Integration
templates.creator: cliphouse.studio
templates.prompt: A 16:9 integration announcement. The product mark, built from the brand text, meets a plug or connector shape that snaps in, the headline names the integration (for example "Relay + Linear"), the subhead says what it does, and the CTA closes.

templates.title: Pricing Update
templates.creator: cliphouse.studio
templates.prompt: A 1:1 pricing update. The plan name and the new price land with weight, a note gives the billing unit, up to three included items appear, and the CTA closes. Clear and honest, not a discount ad.

templates.title: Waitlist
templates.creator: cliphouse.studio
templates.prompt: A 9:16 waitlist teaser for a product that is coming soon. A launch date, a headline that teases the product, a subhead with one line of promise, and a strong CTA to join the waitlist. Builds anticipation.

templates.title: Launch Day
templates.creator: cliphouse.studio
templates.prompt: A 1:1 launch-day post for a Product Hunt or Hacker News style launch. "We are live" energy: the date line, the product name and tagline, then a CTA asking for support. Feels like a countdown that hits zero.

templates.title: Release Notes
templates.creator: cliphouse.studio
templates.prompt: A 16:9 release notes video for a changelog page or YouTube. A version and date header, then up to six notes that type or slide in one per beat like a terminal or a document, then the CTA. Developer-friendly and calm.

templates.title: Before and Now
templates.creator: cliphouse.studio
templates.prompt: A 4:5 before-and-now launch post. The old way (the subhead) sits on one side of a split, a wipe crosses the frame and reveals the new way (the headline), then the brand and CTA. Makes an improvement obvious.

templates.title: Customer Quote
templates.creator: cliphouse.studio
templates.prompt: A 1:1 social-proof post for a launch. A short customer quote lands word by word, the author and their company appear, then the brand and CTA. Warm and credible, not a generic testimonial card.

templates.title: API Release
templates.creator: cliphouse.studio
templates.prompt: A 16:9 API release video. The version and date sit in a header bar, the headline names the release, then up to four lines of example code type into an editor pane one per beat (a request, a flag, a response field), then the CTA as an install or docs command. Monospace, precise, developer-first.

templates.title: Breaking Change
templates.creator: cliphouse.studio
templates.prompt: A 4:5 breaking change or deprecation notice. A warning band slides across, the headline names what is going away, the removal date lands like a deadline, up to three lines say what changes, then the CTA to the migration guide. Clear and calm: a notice, not an alarm.

templates.title: Migration Guide
templates.creator: cliphouse.studio
templates.prompt: A 16:9 "upgrade to the new version" walkthrough. The headline names the upgrade, then up to four numbered steps advance along a progress rail one per beat, each step checking off as the next begins, then the CTA. Feels like a guided terminal session that ends green.

templates.title: Code Diff
templates.creator: cliphouse.studio
templates.prompt: A 1:1 code diff post. The headline frames the change, then up to six diff lines print one per beat in a gutter with line markers: lines that start with "-" are removals, lines that start with "+" are additions, other lines are context. Read the marker from the item text at runtime, show it in the gutter, and never depend on leading spaces (the editor trims them). The removed lines strike out, the added lines settle in, then the CTA. Built for "look how much simpler this is" posts.

templates.title: GitHub Stars
templates.creator: cliphouse.studio
templates.prompt: A 1:1 open-source milestone post. A star counter ticks up and locks on the stat, the headline says what was reached, the subhead thanks the community, then the CTA. A field of small marks, one per beat, fills the frame like a contribution graph. Grateful, credible, and a little proud.

templates.title: Contributors
templates.creator: cliphouse.studio
templates.prompt: A 4:5 contributor shoutout for a release or a month of open source. The headline thanks the community, then up to six contributor handles land one per beat like name tags or commit avatars built from their initials, the date names the release or month, then the CTA invites new contributors.

templates.title: Roadmap
templates.creator: cliphouse.studio
templates.prompt: A 16:9 public roadmap update. The headline and the quarter (the date) set it up, then up to five roadmap items land on a horizontal track one per beat. The first item is marked as in progress, the rest are queued behind it, then the CTA. Calm, structured, and honest.

templates.title: Benchmark
templates.creator: cliphouse.studio
templates.prompt: A 16:9 benchmark result. The headline states the claim, then up to four bars race to their values one per beat, with the first item highlighted as the product, the subhead names the method, then the CTA. Each list item is a label and a number, such as "Forge 1.2". Engineering-credible, not a marketing chart.

templates.title: Model Release
templates.creator: cliphouse.studio
templates.prompt: A 1:1 AI model release card. The model name lands as the hero, a headline eval score locks in as the stat, the subhead says what the score measures, up to three capabilities appear, then the CTA to try it in the API. Precise and modern, like a lab release note, without sci-fi cliches.

templates.title: Status Update
templates.creator: cliphouse.studio
templates.prompt: A 16:9 incident resolved update. A status light settles from alert to resolved, the headline names the outcome, the date gives the incident window, up to four timeline entries print one per beat on a vertical log, then the CTA to the postmortem. Transparent and steady.

templates.title: Security Advisory
templates.creator: cliphouse.studio
templates.prompt: A 4:5 security advisory. The severity score locks into a badge as the stat, the headline says to patch and names the fixed version, the subhead states the issue in one sentence, then the CTA to the advisory. Urgent but measured: a responsible disclosure, not a scare.

templates.title: Docs Launch
templates.creator: cliphouse.studio
templates.prompt: A 16:9 documentation launch. A docs sidebar builds itself: up to four section names land one per beat as navigation items while a page frame assembles beside them, the headline names the new docs, the subhead gives the promise, then the CTA as the docs address.

templates.title: Hackathon
templates.creator: cliphouse.studio
templates.prompt: A 9:16 hackathon promo. The event name lands big, the dates and the city (the date role) follow, the prize pool slams in as the stat, the subhead gives the theme, then the CTA to register. Energetic and builder-friendly, like a terminal prompt that turns into a poster.

templates.title: Dev Talk
templates.creator: cliphouse.studio
templates.prompt: A 16:9 conference talk promo. The talk title is the hero, the speaker name and role land as the author, the conference and room land as the attribution, the date and time follow, then the CTA. Feels like a talk title slide that comes alive, not a generic speaker card.

templates.title: Open Source
templates.creator: cliphouse.studio
templates.prompt: A 1:1 "now open source" announcement. A closed box or lock opens to reveal the headline, the subhead names the license and what is included, then the CTA as the repository address. Generous and confident, the moment a team gives its code away.

templates.title: Hook and Answer
templates.creator: cliphouse.studio
templates.prompt: A 9:16 hook-and-answer clip for Reels, TikTok, and Shorts. Beat one stops the scroll: the headline is a blunt question or pain the audience feels, big and alone on screen. Then the answer: the question visibly flips into the answer (a strike, a crack, or a wipe), the subhead names the product and how it solves the pain, up to three benefits land one per beat, and the CTA closes. The arc must read as problem, then fix.

templates.title: Quickstart
templates.creator: cliphouse.studio
templates.prompt: A 16:9 quickstart video: how fast a developer goes from nothing to running. An elapsed-time readout counts up toward the stat while up to three commands type into a terminal one per beat, each finishing with a success mark. The clock locks on the stat as the last command lands, the headline states the promise, then the CTA. Speed and ease are shown, not claimed.

templates.title: How It Works
templates.creator: cliphouse.studio
templates.prompt: A 1:1 "how it works in 3 steps" explainer for a product page or a launch thread. The headline sets it up, then up to three numbered steps land one per beat, linked by a path that draws from one step to the next. Each step gets a simple glyph built from shapes (no icons, no images). Then the CTA. A stranger must understand the product in 10 seconds.

templates.title: Founder Note
templates.creator: cliphouse.studio
templates.prompt: A 4:5 founder note: the personal "why we built this" post that small startups share on launch day. The headline lands first, then the note writes itself in, phrase by phrase, like a letter on paper. The founder name and role sign it off, then the brand and CTA. Warm, human, and editorial, never corporate.

templates.title: Weekly Shipped
templates.creator: cliphouse.studio
templates.prompt: A 9:16 weekly "what we shipped" recap for Stories, Reels, and Shorts, for teams that build in public. The week label stamps in, then up to five shipped items rise one per beat like cards stacking up a phone screen, while a running count ticks up with each card. Then the CTA. Momentum is the message: a small team that ships every week.

templates.title: Why Switch
templates.creator: cliphouse.studio
templates.prompt: A 1:1 "why teams switch to us" comparison. The headline sets it up, then up to four reasons land one per beat as rows in a two-column table: the brand column and an "old way" column. Each row gets a check under the brand and a muted cross under the old way. The columns and marks are drawn decoration; only the brand and the row text are editable. Confident, and never mocking a named competitor.

templates.title: Stat Hook
templates.creator: cliphouse.studio
templates.prompt: A 9:16 one-number hook for Reels, TikTok, and Shorts. The stat fills the screen on the first beat. Then the headline completes the sentence, the subhead gives the proof in one line, then the brand and CTA. One bold claim in huge type, with nothing competing with it.

templates.title: You Asked
templates.creator: cliphouse.studio
templates.prompt: A 1:1 "you asked, we shipped" post. A user request (the quote) appears on a generic feedback or issue card with its author, a status pill flips from open to shipped, the headline lands with weight, then the CTA names the command or page. No third-party logos. It shows a team that listens, and turns a feature into social proof.

templates.title: Feature Demo
templates.creator: cliphouse.studio
templates.prompt: A 16:9 feature demo without a screenshot. An app window built from shapes (a title bar, a sidebar, content blocks, all in theme colors) assembles, and the headline names the feature. Then a cursor performs up to three actions, one per beat. Each action label appears as a caption while the mock UI responds: a row highlights, a panel slides in, a draft fills. Then the CTA. It must read as a product demo even though no real UI is shown.

templates.title: Launch Week
templates.creator: cliphouse.studio
templates.prompt: A 16:9 launch week announcement, for startups that ship one big thing a day for a week. The date names the day (for example "Launch Week / Day 3"). A day track runs along the frame and up to five launch items land on it one per beat: the last item is today and gets the highlight. Then the headline announces today's launch, the subhead says what it does, and the CTA closes.

templates.title: Built For
templates.creator: cliphouse.studio
templates.prompt: A 4:5 positioning clip that says who the product is for. The headline ("Built for") holds in place while up to five audience names swap into the slot after it, one per beat, like a split-flap or a roll. The last name holds, then the subhead states the promise and the CTA closes. It answers "is this for me?" at a glance.

templates.title: Works With
templates.creator: cliphouse.studio
templates.prompt: A 1:1 "works with your stack" post. The brand sits at the center as a hub, then up to six integration names land one per beat as text tiles around it, each joined to the hub by a line that draws as it lands. Then the headline and CTA. Tiles are text only, with no logos. It answers "will it fit what we already use?"
